Mechanics follow ex-tales-forge main (Game.Mechanics: 1d20 roll-under vs skill + (stat-10) div 2) Learning rule per decision 2026-10-09 (Fredrik): learn only from failure, only in the failed skill, improvement after sleeping; being rolled out, so a success earns nothing.. playtest_series.note: Confidence-weighted turn score per persona. All four series use the same rubric versions (Paul fd84ebb, Lotta ce84a1a; others unchanged) so they are comparable.
